items.summary: TheRock's Windows ROCm SDK ships lib/llvm/bin/flang.exe and amdflang.exe that are actually clang driver binaries, not Flang. They advertise 'AMD flang version 23.0.0git / Target: x86_64-pc-windows-msvc', but 'flang.exe -fc1 -help' prints 'OVERVIEW: clang LLVM compiler', -fc1 is an unknown argument, and compiling any .f90 fails because the driver spawns itself with frontend flags it cannot parse. No flang_rt runtime libraries and no Fortran .mod files (iso_fortran_env, __fortran_builtins) are packaged anywhere in the SDK. Either ship a real Flang with its runtime and modules on Windows, or do not ship a binary named flang -- the current state makes it look like Fortran is supported when it is not, and blocks mixed Fortran/HIP projects such as QUICK.
